signature.name: VTask.sumMap
signature.type: {L : FirstOrder.Language} -> {L' : FirstOrder.Language} -> (ϕ : L →ᴸ L') -> {L₁ : FirstOrder.Language} -> {L₂ : FirstOrder.Language} -> (ψ : L₁ →ᴸ L₂) -> L.sum L₁ →ᴸ L'.sum L₂

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.sumMap is a total construction; it takes any two language homomorphisms and produces a language homomorphism between the corresponding sum languages with no junk-value or degenerate-case conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : (FirstOrder.Language.empty).Relations n), (VTask.sumMap (FirstOrder.Language.LHom.id FirstOrder.Language.empty) (FirstOrder.Language.LHom.id FirstOrder.Language.empty)).onRelation (Sum.inl r) = Sum.inl ((FirstOrder.Language.LHom.id FirstOrder.Language.empty).onRelation r)
